mutations.Explanation: For CENTER alignment, the left padding is calculated using a ceiling-like split instead of floor, placing the extra space on the left instead of the right. This subtly flips the expected left/right distribution for odd padding lengths.
For CENTER alignment with an undefined max width, padding is applied regardless of the addIndent flag, causing padding to appear even when addIndent is false.
When maxWidth is set, the remaining padding length is reduced by one before distribution, creating a subtle off-by-one error in the total padding for LEFT and RIGHT alignments.
